highlights.title: A first screen anyone can start from
highlights.text: A fresh install starts with @helpers: Assistant, Researcher and Writer. Your own bots and teams stay as they are. Dev mode and Approvals now live in Settings › This space › General.

highlights.title: Done items say what checked them
highlights.text: A done item in the Inbox shows Checked, Partly checked, Failed or Not checked above the answer, with the list of checks and their evidence.

highlights.title: Try again on a pre-push card lets the push go
highlights.text: Press "Ask Ben to try again" and Ben's next push of that branch goes once its checks pass, with no second card. The card follows it to Pushed.

highlights.title: Checks can wait for outside services
highlights.text: A mission check can wait for a store review or a build farm: it runs again every 15 minutes with no bot turns, and tells you after 72 hours.

highlights.title: A chat says when it's waiting for you
highlights.text: When a bot only needs your answer, one amber line says so, with Answer to jump to the question. Press a choice or just type your reply.

highlights.title: A routine's run shows as a routine
highlights.text: A routine's message in a chat is one row with a clock and the routine's name, not a You bubble. Press it to read the instructions.

fixes: With no AI account yet, your first message no longer makes a Concierge that can't answer; you get the Add an account card.
Don't ask now also covers work a bot starts on its own; payments and production changes still ask.
A mission task whose browser stays busy now ends once with a fix line, instead of running the whole task again.
A message to a paused bot shows only the pause bar, and a bot pinned to an AI that can't run shows a grey dot.
Adding a tool from the public directory no longer fails until you rename it.
"Select video" and other file pickers in the live browser view now open a Choose file… sheet, where clicking them did nothing.
